entries.name: marionette-web-design
entries.description: Use when designing, building or restyling a website or landing page (offer, copy, outline, palette, fonts, layout), when asking which design system, palette, typography or accessibility and UX rules suit an app screen, dashboard or component, or when creating or updating designs, components and tokens inside a Figma file. Not for a clickable prototype of app screens in HTML.

entries.name: marionette-product-design
entries.description: Use when sketching wireframes or a few low-fidelity layouts of a screen or flow, choosing a look for an app or product that has no brand or design system, building a clickable hi-fi prototype or mockup of app screens in HTML, wanting several design variations or a live tweak panel to play with colours, fonts and layout, or making a slide deck as an HTML page that runs in the browser. Not for a company website or landing page, a PowerPoint file, or shipping the screen in the product's production code.

entries.name: marionette-design-review
entries.description: Use when checking and fixing an existing HTML design or web interface before it is shown or shipped: accessibility (contrast, keyboard, focus, labels), a generic AI-made look, visual hierarchy and spacing rhythm, missing hover, focus, disabled or loading states, or a full polish pass; or when extracting design tokens from a brand, codebase, site or screenshots into a tokens file, or listing the reusable components of a design as an inventory. Not for a code review of logic, for fact-checking content or for changes inside a Figma file.

entries.name: marionette-motion
entries.description: Use when deciding how an interface moves (purpose, durations, easing, choreography, reduced-motion alternatives) or when implementing scroll-linked animation, pinning, scrub, parallax or horizontal scroll sections with GSAP ScrollTrigger or pure CSS scroll-driven timelines.

entries.name: marionette-office
entries.description: Use when producing a real PowerPoint deck, Word document, Excel workbook or PDF file from a brief, notes or data, or when reading, extracting from, editing, filling, converting or redlining an existing Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF file. Not for text wanted only in the chat or as Markdown.

entries.name: marionette-explainer
entries.description: Use when turning a paper, article, transcript, topic or one mechanism of a codebase into a self-contained interactive HTML explainer with figures the reader can operate, or when fact-checking an existing explainer or article claim by claim against its sources or code. Not for an explanation wanted in the chat.

entries.name: marionette-engineering
entries.description: Use when implementing a software change, fixing a bug, or coordinating a larger change: agreeing the destination, resolving open decisions, writing a spec, slicing vertical tickets, then building and reviewing with test evidence; or when recording, preparing or resuming a HANDOFF.md across sessions. A clear small change is implemented directly. Not for a report-only code review or a shortcut inventory.

entries.name: marionette-papers
entries.description: Use when finding research papers, related work or prior art, reading a paper from its arXiv id, DOI or PubMed id, adding papers to a paper wiki with topic and concept pages and validating it, or making a publication-quality paper figure: an editable draw.io method or architecture diagram, or a matplotlib plot from results data. Not for a web search on a non-academic subject or a chart for a dashboard.

entries.name: marionette-research
entries.description: Use when planning ML or AI research (choosing a problem, a research plan, an experiment loop, a reading plan, a research log), debugging a training run or an evaluation that misbehaves, or pitching and positioning research for an advisor, reviewer, collaborator or talk audience without overclaiming, including checking a pitch for claims the evidence does not support.

entries.name: marionette-token-economy
entries.description: Use when the user asks what TokenEconomizer learned or saved in this repository or what their agent sessions cost, wants to see or change its repository facts (micro-skills), its tool pruning deny list or its loop guard, to give pruned tools back, to change its settings, or to turn its automatic mode on or off for a project. Not for questions about model pricing or for shrinking a prompt by hand.

entries.name: marionette-code-review
entries.description: Use when reviewing code changes for correctness, reliability and unnecessary complexity, auditing the whole repository beyond the diff, or listing deliberate shortcut comments with their limits and upgrade triggers. Reports findings; applies no fixes unless implementation is also requested. Not for visual design reviews, research fact-checking or agent session cost reports.

entries.name: marionette-working-method
entries.description: Use when asking how the absorbed Ponytail working method works, what its lite, full and ultra preferences mean, or what its published benchmark measured and what its limits are. Not for measuring current repository savings, changing a persistent source-plugin mode or reviewing code.
